FORM 10-K
Fiscal year ended September 27, 2025

Item 1. Business

BUSINESS_BODY. The company designs and sells industrial sensing systems and related software.

Its non-calendar fiscal year contains fifty-two or fifty-three weeks and ends in September.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

INCORPORATED_RISK_BODY. The risk factors are supplemented by information incorporated by reference from Part III.

Material risks include component concentration, cybersecurity, regulation, and foreign exchange exposure.

Item 1B. Unresolved Staff Comments

ITEM_ONE_B_BODY. None.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

ANNUAL_MDA_BODY. Revenue increased because recurring software demand offset lower hardware volume.

Management evaluated liquidity, cash requirements, margins, and capital allocation for the fiscal year.

Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

ANNUAL_MARKET_RISK_BODY. The company uses sensitivity analysis for interest rates and foreign currencies.

No calendar-year assumption is required to identify this canonical disclosure.

FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_BODY. Audited statements follow.
